items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I've got his address in my pocket... I ain't seen him in about, oh, three or four, four, five years or longer. Because here about four or five months ago he comes through here.

ctx.x: Yeah. I don't know why he's at, but he's around here someplace. And James Dewberry. He's a one-legged boy. He's in St. Louis. I've got his address in my pocket. He plays good guitar. He's like right off and under me and son of the room. Yeah, well shaved, you might call it.
